svg.title: Cost per solved task on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 sessions, by task class
svg.text: Lower is cheaper. Each status compares the router with the best baseline.
Opus 5.5 session: PARTIAL in 2 of 8, FAIL in 6 of 8 classes
Sonnet 5.5 session: PARTIAL in 2 of 8, FAIL in 6 of 8 classes
5 or 10 runs per class and configuration. PASS means cheaper
per solved task than the best baseline, with the whole 95%
interval of the difference below zero, at a pass rate not
behind it. Source: docs/BENCHMARKS.md, 1120 runs on
